en: The Triplet of the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad of the Mundane (Lokiyaduka)

Conditioned by a mundane state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor reactive and not supramundane arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a supramundane state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor reactive and not supramundane arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six for root; six for predominance ... [and so on] ... six for non-disappearance.
